candidate.problem: writeExportFile swallows any mkdir/writeFile failure (it only logs, and only when KERYX_VERBOSE is set) and returns normally. Its only caller, runHistoryExport (line 122), then prints `exported N run(s) to <file>` at line 131 and exits 0. That is the silent catch error-handling.mdc Rule 3 / Iron Law 1 forbids: the caller goes on as if the write succeeded.
